sources.title: The Ransomware an AI Model Built Without Trying - CyberHoot
sources.snippet: Researchers went looking for a fake photo upscaler and found something stranger: a ransomware kit an AI model helped design without anyone teaching it how. No skilled coder sat down and wrote this attack line by line.
